routes.notes: accepts {"url": ...}; server fetches the URL and returns title + body snippet

observations: POST /api/preview with a JSON body {"url": "https://example.com"} makes the server fetch that URL and return its title and a body snippet.
The url parameter is not validated against an allowlist; internal hosts and link-local addresses are reachable.
POST /api/preview with {"url": "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/"} returns cloud instance metadata in the snippet.
No egress filtering or scheme restriction is visible in observed behavior.
